# AAT — Adaptive API Toolkit

> A Go CLI that models an API as a graph and runs long, multi-step test plans against it: values wired between steps, layers for matrix testing, multiple environments, run archives, and an MCP server for AI coding tools. Execution never calls an LLM.

An AI coding assistant needs one document to author and run an AAT project: the primer below. It covers the project files, the edit, validate, run loop, and how to read what a run recorded. The same Markdown is built into the CLI: `aat docs primer` prints the version that matches the installed binary.

## Primer

- [AAT for AI Assistants](https://gburgyan.github.io/aat/llms-full.txt): the full primer, as Markdown

## Reference pages

- [Project setup](https://gburgyan.github.io/aat/project-setup/): the manifest and the project layout
- [API graphs](https://gburgyan.github.io/aat/graphs/): nodes, inputs, outputs, ordering, and cleanup
- [Templates](https://gburgyan.github.io/aat/templates/): requests and response extraction
- [Lua transforms](https://gburgyan.github.io/aat/lua-transforms/): outputs computed from a response
- [Environments](https://gburgyan.github.io/aat/environments/): base URLs, auth, and multiple environments
- [Plans and recipes](https://gburgyan.github.io/aat/plans/): steps, values, assertions, and layers
- [Workflows](https://gburgyan.github.io/aat/workflows/): slots, addons, and composition
- [Value resolution](https://gburgyan.github.io/aat/value-flow/): how each input gets its value
- [Running tests](https://gburgyan.github.io/aat/running/): run commands and flags
- [Matrix testing](https://gburgyan.github.io/aat/batch-layers/): layer groups and duplicate detection
- [Archives](https://gburgyan.github.io/aat/archives/): what a run records, and `aat run show`
- [Checkpoints](https://gburgyan.github.io/aat/checkpoints/): stopping a run and handing its state to another tool
- [Validation](https://gburgyan.github.io/aat/validation/): what `aat validate` checks
- [MCP server](https://gburgyan.github.io/aat/mcp-server/): tools for AI coding assistants
